info.name: Baserow API spec Admin Health API

params.name: queue
params.description: The name of the queues to check. Can be provided multiple times. Accepts either `celery` or `export`.

items.docs: Health check endpoint to check if the the celery and/or export celery queue has  exceeded the maximum healthy size. Responds with `200` if there there are less than 10 in all queues provided. Otherwise responds with a `503`.
Sends a test email to the provided email address. Useful for testing Baserow's email configuration as errors are clearly returned.
Runs a full health check testing as many services and systems as possible. These health checks can be expensive operations such as writing files to storage etc.
